select substr(r_reason_desc,1,20) ,avg(ws_quantity) ,avg(wr_refunded_cash) ,avg(wr_fee) 
from web_sales ws
join web_returns wr on ws_item_sk = wr_item_sk and ws_order_number = wr_order_number
join web_page wp on ws_web_page_sk = wp_web_page_sk
join customer_demographics cd1 on cd1.cd_demo_sk = wr_refunded_cdemo_sk
join (select cd_demo_sk, cd_marital_status, cd_education_status from customer_demographics where cd_marital_status in ('D', 'S', 'U') and cd_education_status in ('Primary', 'College', 'Advanced Degree')) cd2 on cd2.cd_demo_sk = wr_returning_cdemo_sk
join (select address_sk, country, state, net_profit from customer_address where country = 'United States' and state in ('NC', 'TX', 'IA', 'WI', 'WV', 'GA', 'OK', 'VA', 'KY')) ca on ca.address_sk = wr_refunded_addr_sk
join date_dim d on ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk and d_year = 1998
join reason r on r_reason_sk = wr_reason_sk
where (cd1.cd_marital_status = 'D' and cd2.cd_marital_status = 'D' and cd1.cd_education_status = 'Primary' and cd2.cd_education_status = 'Primary' and ws_sales_price between 100.00 and 150.00)
   or (cd1.cd_marital_status = 'S' and cd2.cd_marital_status = 'S' and cd1.cd_education_status = 'College' and cd2.cd_education_status = 'College' and ws_sales_price between 50.00 and 100.00)
   or (cd1.cd_marital_status = 'U' and cd2.cd_marital_status = 'U' and cd1.cd_education_status = 'Advanced Degree' and cd2.cd_education_status = 'Advanced Degree' and ws_sales_price between 150.00 and 200.00)
   or (ca.country = 'United States' and ca.state in ('NC', 'TX', 'IA') and ws_net_profit between 100 and 200)
   or (ca.country = 'United States' and ca.state in ('WI', 'WV', 'GA') and ws_net_profit between 150 and 300)
   or (ca.country = 'United States' and ca.state in ('OK', 'VA', 'KY') and ws_net_profit between 50 and 250)
group by r_reason_desc
order by substr(r_reason_desc,1,20) ,avg(ws_quantity) ,avg(wr_refunded_cash) ,avg(wr_fee)
limit 100
